method: Quran Arabic and English read in Quran.net and Quran.vc; Ezekiel 47:12 Hebrew Masoretic and Sefaria English checked; source-specific checks for remaining verses limited; no historical dependence asserted.

records.note: Mountain movement, speaking dead, divine guidance and punishment; no source-specific prior text established in this pass. Do not confuse broad miraculous motifs with a literary parallel.
Earlier messengers mocked and delayed punishment; no exact independently checked source passage. Requires prophetic narrative review.
God overseeing every soul versus invented partners: broad polemical motif; no distinct passage-level parallel established.
Punishment in this life and hereafter is general eschatological doctrine; no distinctive earlier passage identified.

candidate_locators.tradition: Hebrew Bible; prophetic temple restoration vision
candidate_locators.relation: specific imagery parallel with material differences
candidate_locators.verification: Masoretic Hebrew and Sefaria English inspected; critical apparatus and manuscript witnesses not collated
candidate_locators.similarities: River and enduring fruit/tree provision imagery; Ezekiel's fruit does not fail and leaves do not wither, Qur'an promises unceasing provision and shade.
candidate_locators.differences: Ezekiel's stream issues from a restored sanctuary and leaves heal; Quran 13:35 describes the promised garden of the righteous, continuous food and shade, contrasted with the fire; it does not mention temple or healing leaves.
candidate_locators.dating: Ezekiel's prophetic material conventionally associated with sixth-century BCE Babylonian exile, but book composition/redaction and extant manuscript witnesses require distinct critical documentation.

checkpoint.caveat: Verify against all unmerged PR and Supabase unique keys before treating as first globally unreviewed range.
